verified_behaviors: single-flight rebuild produces one database load
compare-and-delete prevents an expired holder from deleting a new lock owner
SQLite conditional decrement does not oversell in the lab
Redis Lua pre-deduction prevents oversell and duplicate grants
successful grants reconcile with persisted orders
limitations: Single Redis node; no cluster, failover or network partition
SQLite is not MySQL InnoDB; no MySQL lock/MVCC acceptance
No MQ, consumer retry, hot-key capacity or production load test
The minimal RESP client is for labs only
